name: Sea Pavilion — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Very open seaside pavilion under a turquoise glass/shell canopy with multiple pointed petal lobes, gold ribs, nacre columns/screens and central shell basin. It is not the same circular glass dome as B20. Hidden layout inference: A short shore/dock approach reaches a compact shell courtyard, visitors pass around the basin to a sea-facing balcony and return around the open edge. Keep slender bays and water view unobstructed; a few marine planters soften the landing without filling the hall. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B23-STRUCT-001 — Sea Pavilion — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need petal-roof/rib springing modules, nacre column/corner seats, shell-screen end joints and shore-platform threshold. Existing shell basin and jali motifs are source vocabulary; use shared water/dock/rocks. Coastal vines/planters/seaweed and reef fish/shorebirds proposed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
